subject: Technical evaluation milestones & ownership — draft (next steps)
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@healthgrid.io>, Samir Desai <samir.desai@healthgrid.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Technical evaluation milestones & ownership — draft (next steps)

Thanks again for the call this morning — productive session and good alignment on objectives. Attached is a lean draft of the technical evaluation milestones we discussed (see "benchmark-specs.xlsx"). Please review and confirm owners/target dates. High-level recap and asks below: 

Summary objective: Run a focused technical evaluation that proves model quality and operational economics for HealthGrid's chat assistant workload (realistic payloads, 1–2 turn flows, safety filters). Target close for MAP milestone: 2026-08-06 (final decision to proceed to pilot).

Proposed milestones (draft):
1) Environment & access (owner: HealthGrid - Samir) — dataset access (anonymized sample), test account, firewall/IP allowlist. Target: 2026-07-16.
2) Smoke tests & model shortlist (owner: Redwood - Marissa) — run quick throughput/sanity checks on 3 candidate models. Target: 2026-07-22.
3) Formal benchmarks (owner: Redwood - Rafael) — latency (P95) & cost targets, accuracy sweep vs. benchmark prompts, safety/regression checks. Target: 2026-07-29.
4) Security/compliance check (owner: HealthGrid — Aisha + Redwood security) — review SOC2 artifacts, data handling, retention. Target: 2026-07-26 (parallel).
5) Procurement & PO issuance (owner: HealthGrid procurement) — finalize SOW/PO if targets met. Target: 2026-08-06.

Benchmark success criteria (proposed):
- Latency: P95 generation latency for 1k-token equivalent prompt/response under 300ms for hosted endpoint; for dedicated target P95 < 200ms.
- Cost: amortized inference cost per 1k input+output tokens <= $0.40 (goal for pilot configuration).
- Quality: pass >= 95% of correctness/intent tests on the supplied prompt set; no safety regression vs baseline.

Dependencies/risks: dataset delivery, whitelist IPs, SOC2 evidence, ESA (if necessary), and procurement lead times.

Next steps I propose: HealthGrid to confirm owners and dataset ETA by 2026-07-14. Redwood to update the benchmark workbook and schedule the smoke-run calendar invites once data access is confirmed.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: rg-quick-proposal.pdf, benchmark-specs.xlsx
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@healthgrid.io>

Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Technical evaluation milestones & ownership — draft (next steps)

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the clear plan. Quick notes from our side after internal sync: 

- Ownership tweaks: HealthGrid will own Environment & access (Samir), Security/compliance will be Aisha + our security lead (I copied Samir). Procurement is owned by me (Aisha) for tracking, but legal will sign.
- Latency target: can you clarify P95 measurement window (end-to-end vs inference-only)? For our procurement we prefer end-to-end numbers (includes network hop). If Redwood measures inference-only, please provide both.
- Cost target: $0.40 per 1k tokens looks reasonable as a goal. Can you provide a quick sensitivity table (best/likely/worst) in the workbook?
- Smoke test ask: please include a 'sanity' subset of 50 prompts (we have a redacted set) for the initial smoke run — we can deliver that by 2026-07-15.

We are tight on calendar in late July; if benchmarks spill > 1 week, procurement timing will shift. Asking for 1-week buffer into the target close date if needed.

I'll confirm dataset delivery ETA by EOD Monday (July 13).

Best,
Aisha
Director, Product — HealthGrid
aisha.khan@healthgrid.io
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

Appreciate the clarifications — quick responses inline and a slight calendar update below.

- Measurement: we'll provide both inference-only (server-side) and end-to-end (measured from HealthGrid test account) P50/P95 numbers.
- Sensitivity: adding best/likely/worst cost bands in the workbook — will attach updated sheet by Monday.
- Smoke prompts: we can consume your 50 redacted prompts for the smoke run — Samir, let us know where to pull them (S3 link or Drive).

Revised schedule (shortened where feasible):
- Dataset access confirmed: 2026-07-16
- Smoke tests (50 prompts): 2026-07-20
- Model shortlist finalization: 2026-07-22
- Formal benchmarks complete: 2026-07-30 (one day later than original to allow end-to-end measurement)
- Go/no-go decision & procurement kickoff: 2026-08-06

If HealthGrid needs a one-week buffer on PO we can plan for 2026-08-13 as contingency. I'll update the MAP doc and re-upload the workbook.

— Rafael
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@healthgrid.io>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Samir Desai <samir.desai@healthgrid.io>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Technical evaluation milestones & ownership — draft (next steps)

Adding a quick note on model shortlist and evaluation approach from the Redwood side. Rafael, I'm attaching the quick model matrix inside the benchmark workbook. Proposed candidate models for the pilot (prioritized for quality → cost):
- Llama-3-70B (quantized) — expected high-quality, higher throughput cost.
- Mistral-Instruct-7B (dense / int8) — strong instruction quality, lower cost footprint.
- OpenLLaMA-13B (int8) — middle ground; good for latency-sensitive paths.

Evaluation plan (short):
- Smoke run across all three candidates (50 prompts) — correctness and safety quick checks.
- Full benchmark (3–5k prompts) on top 2 models after smoke pass — measure P50/P95, token cost, and throughput at 50 and 200 concurrent sessions.
- Success criteria: P95 inference-only under 250ms for dedicated-like configs OR end-to-end P95 under 320ms for hosted; cost-per-1k tokens baseline <= $0.40 with target improvements measured after batching/kv-cache tweaks.

Jordan (cc'd) will coordinate access to a small PS engagement if we need engineered optimizations for the shortlist — Jordan, can you confirm availability the week of Jul 27?

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
